messages:
Sophia P.: sharing a short deck — want rapid alignment on orchestration roadmap hypotheses and top customer asks. link: https://tiny.redwood/orch-roadmap-deck
Leo K.: skimmed. high level looks good. curious about canary flows for cross-region model fallback — do we have acceptance criteria?
A.J.: canary acceptance = < 1% error delta, latency delta <= 50ms p95, and no token-drop regressions. we should encode as simple gate in the rollout API.
Maria (PM): +1. also need to surface customer-priority list. sales sent 3 asks: residency SLAs, predictable burst capacity, and per-customer routing overrides.
Sophia P.: noted. thinking of a priority rubric: impact x implementation cost x dependency-risk. propose bands: critical / high / medium / backlog.
Leo K.: sounds reasonable. quick question: how do we treat Dedicated vs Hosted parity? customers expect feature parity for routing policy but we may phase it.
A.J.: proposal: parity for policy DSL in control plane day1, runtime enforcement phased (hosted -> dedicated -> private). means customers can author policies consistently.
Maria (PM): that helps sales messaging. can we list launch criteria per band? even a short YAML would help engineering and legal.
Sophia P.: here's a draft YAML for launch gates:
```
launch_gates:
  critical:
    - sla_targets: ">=99.9% uptime"
    - latency_budget: "p95 <= 200ms region-local"
    - security: "kms + audit logs"
  high:
    - sla_targets: ">=99.5%"
    - canary_policy: "automated rollback on delta>1%"
```
Jordan OpsBot: deploy-bot: canary job scheduled for 2025-07-02 18:00 UTC (dry-run). :rocket:
Leo K.: couple notes: 1) we need telemetry hooks for policy decision tracing; 2) prefetched KV cache implications on cross-region fallbacks.
A.J.: agreed. telemetry: include route_decision_id and model_variant_id in traces. cache: add a fallback path that invalidates on region mismatch (cheap to implement).
Maria (PM): from customer asks, residency SLA is most common. we should mark that as critical for regulated accounts.
Sophia P.: action items:
- A.J.: draft control-plane policy schema and migration path (due EOW)
- Leo: instrumentation spec for route traces and cache invalidation (due next Tue)
- Maria: consolidate top 10 customer asks and map to bands (due Wed)
- Sophia: update deck with gates and ship to execs by Fri
Leo K.: acked. will mock trace format: `route_decision_id:uuid, outcome:allow|fallback, latency_ms:int`
A.J.: pseudo-config suggestion for per-tenant override: "tenant_overrides": [{"tenant_id":"T123","route_preference":"region-us-east"}]
Maria (PM): pinging sales to prioritize the 10 asks list now.
Sophia P.: final thought — keep rollout conservative: feature parity without guaranteeing identical perf initially. call out measurable regressions and rollback thresholds in the deck.
Leo K.: :thumbsup:
Jordan OpsBot: reminder: weekly orchestration sync Tue 16:00 UTC. added to calendar.
Sophia P.: thanks all — will post updated deck and follow up on PRs.
